newsitem.title: GERMANY: German lower house passes 1997 tax bill.
newsitem.headline: German lower house passes 1997 tax bill.

text.p: Germany's Bundestag lower house of parliament on Thursday voted through Finance Minister Theo Waigel's 1997 tax bill by a majority of 335 to 318 votes.
The bill, which has been watered down after parts were blocked by the opposition Social Democrats (SPD), abolishes an assets tax ruled illegal by the constitutional court.
Among other measures, the bill would also raise tax-free inheritance allowances retroactively from January 1 this year.
The bill will now go to the SPD-controlled upper house of parliament, which is likely then to send it to parliament's mediation committee to iron out final disagreements.
